name: urbanflow-design
description: Design, explore, QA and hand off Flux and urbanflow frontend changes with the Flow Design System.

interface.longDescription: One designer workflow for Flux and urbanflow: Figma and Flow DS updates, local flow previews and design explorations, frontend QA fixes, exact-branch validation and requested PR handoff. Requires separately authorized Figma, local development and GitHub tools for those actions.
